title: Deterministic Input Cost
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates that computes a function $f$, and let $x$ be an input. The expected number of queries made by the randomized tree obtained by choosing $T$ deterministically, on input $x$, equals the number of queries made by $T$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates
